description: Main source file for a Flutter-based food delivery app, defining app structure, navigation, and UI components.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget initializing the app with routes and BLoC providers.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: Main screen with navigation drawer, user info, and food items list.

classes.name: ItemContainer
classes.description: Widget representing individual food item with add to cart functionality.

classes.name: FirstHalf
classes.description: Widget containing app header, search bar, and categories.

classes.name: Items
classes.description: Widget displaying food item details including image, name, price, and hotel.

classes.name: CategoryListItem
classes.description: Widget representing a food category with icon, name, availability, and selection state.

classes.name: CustomAppBar
classes.description: Custom app bar with menu icon and cart item count, navigates to cart page.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, sets platform override and runs MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for various widgets, constructing UI components.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a food item to the cart via Bloc.

methods.name: removeFromList
methods.description: Removes a food item from the cart via Bloc.

methods.name: buildGestureDetector
methods.description: Builds a gesture detector for cart icon with item count.
